description: Extract every quantity — a number with a unit — from a document, with the text as written and its value in one base unit: durations in milliseconds, sizes in bytes, percentages as a ratio, frequencies in hertz. Parses JSON, YAML, CSV, TOML, INI and dotenv; anything else is scanned as text, so a format is optional. A quantity it cannot resolve — a bare `m`, a fractional `1.5KB`, a locale-shaped `1,5s`, an expression like `1h + 30m`, an SI byte multiple that may have meant the binary one — is returned with a named reason instead of a guess. A bare number with no unit is not a finding.

dimension.description: Report only one dimension. A refusal that names no dimension is always kept, because it could have been the one asked for.

filename.description: Filename used to infer the format when `format` is absent, e.g. "config.toml".

format.description: Document format. Optional — an unrecognised or absent format scans the text directly.

maxResults.description: Cap on returned quantities (default 500). meta.truncated reports whether any were dropped.

name: extract_units
